info.name: Authorization Administration Logs Device Inspector API

params.name: page
params.description: Number of the requested devices page. Use this parameter to iterate through all devices on the different pages. The total amount of pages is listed in the response body (pageAmount).

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Parameter for specifying the queried items per page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort values based on keys that are listed as a comma seperated list, prepend "-" for descending order.

params.name: q
params.description:
Filter parameter in {filter}:{value} format. Comma separated list of filtering criteria out of the following fields:
  • iccid

Example: "iccid:8988280666000000000"

items.docs: Get a list of all the Customer SIMs/Devices for the current organisation in the 1NCE OS.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: The unique device ID which identifies each 1NCE SIM. Can be obtained from the Get All Devices API query. For 1NCE SIMS the device ID is equal to its iccid.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: This API query uses token-based pagination. Each queried page will include a nextToken for accessing the next page for pagination. Please use the returned token in the nextToken query parameters to obtain the next page.
